text: TRANSFORM currency-only picture (#6168) on fix/transform-currency-picture: '$999' now truncates toward zero, right-aligns in the picture width and puts the dollar sign in the leftmost padding space (VFP9-probed; a value filling the width drops the sign, wider is asterisks). Floating $$ forms, @C/@X suffixes and blank @Z fields were probed and left as separate behavior, listed in the row. #6755 (aggregates) and #6756 (Currency VAL, closes #5996) are open.
